meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会用你提供的 cmem.ai 凭据配置插件,把同步令牌、用户 ID、SyncHub 地址写入配置文件,让记忆钩子能工作;会话结束后插件会重新打包,让你重装以长期生效。
howto.when: 当你说要“设置 claude-mem”、“配对 claude-mem”、“连接 cmem”等,或提供 cmem.ai Connect 的同步令牌、用户 ID、SyncHub URL 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 claude-mem 设置好
我想在 Cowork 里启用云同步
say.note: 按步骤写入凭据并验证连接状态。

say.text: 帮我重新打包插件,让配对永久生效
say.note: 会生成 .plugin 文件交给你重新安装。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude writes your cmem.ai credentials (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) into the plugin config so memory hooks work. It also repackages the plugin at session end so re-installing makes the pairing permanent.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to set up claude-mem, pair claude-mem, connect cmem, etc., or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL).

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem with my credentials.
say_en.note: Prompts for your cmem.ai Connect values and writes them.

say_en.text: Turn on cloud sync in Cowork.
say_en.note: Writes credentials and verifies the hook status.

say_en.text: Repackage the plugin so the pairing stays.
say_en.note: Produces a .plugin file for you to reinstall.
